name: Chidori
description: A concentrated burst of chakra is channeled into one hand, held low and to the side before a forward charging thrust.

steps.instruction: Crouch slightly into a forward-leaning stance.
Draw one hand back at hip height, fingers together and rigid.
Angle the wrist so the palm faces forward, blade-like.
Bend the front knee and shift weight onto your lead foot.
Drive the hand forward in a single straight thrust on release.
